flash_694035.description:
Chinese President Xi Jinping landed at Joint Base Andrews in Maryland on Wednesday, ahead of his summit with US President Donald Trump.

Trump personally arrived at the tarmac to welcome the Chinese president.

flash_694034.description: A Channel 13 News poll shows Naftali Bennett’s Together party falling to a new low of 11 seats, while the Religious Zionist-Zehut alliance remains steady at six.

flash_694032.description: The heads of the Binyamin and Samaria regional councils visit Shaare Zedek Hospital together to stand with the family of Neria Leiter, who was seriously injured: “The government must turn everything upside down."

flash_694039.description:
European Council President António Costa spoke with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian and called on Tehran to resume cooperation with the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA).

Costa also called on Iran to halt attacks against neighboring countries and fully restore freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz.

flash_694038.description: Argentine President Javier Milei blasts the UN as “useless," accusing it of hypocrisy, bureaucratic overreach and bias against Israel in a fiery speech.

flash_694037.description:
Sailors serving aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln faced several self-harm incidents during the months of fighting against Iran, according to a letter from the acting Secretary of the Navy obtained by CNN. He said that none of the crew members died during operations against Iran.

According to CNN, the number of reported cases among the crew was consistent with figures recorded across the US Navy in 2024, when 356 such cases were reported among approximately 337,000 active-duty personnel.

flash_694033.description:
A 13-year-old boy was critically injured after being struck by a car in Kiryat Bialik.

Magen David Adom paramedics provided him with medical treatment and evacuated him to Rambam Hospital in Haifa.

flash_694054.description: Hamas commander Mahmoud Abd al-Fattah Awad helped hold seven Israelis captive in a Gaza tunnel, planned new attacks, and rebuilt Hamas capabilities, IDF reveals.

flash_694053.description: IDF, Shin Bet, eliminate Muhammad Abu Alwan, who directed massive funding for Hamas, worked to rebuild terrorist organization’s capabilities during ceasefire.

flash_694052.description: Ambassador Yechiel Leiter returned to Israel Thursday morning to be with his seriously wounded son, Neria, who underwent hours-long emergency brain surgery overnight.

flash_694050.description: Three years after the October 7 massacre, the Gaza envelope has grown to some 66,000 residents, with more than 90% of evacuated residents back home and thousands of new families moving into the region.

flash_694048.description: How to avoid overlapping investments, cross-border tax surprises, and a portfolio no one understands.

flash_694056.description: Zack Polanski and British Jewry's “suicidal naivety" that believes one more denunciation will finally be enough. Opinion.

flash_694100.description: Prime Minister Netanyahu began his address to the UN General Assembly on Thursday with a call for all "moral cowards" who have not joined the delegations that left his speech to "please do so now."

flash_694099.description: Chants and singing of 'Am Yisrael Chai' as Netanyahu's speech begins

flash_694097.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, today (Thursday, 24 September 2026), met with Slovenian Prime Minister Janez Janša on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly.

Prime Minister Netanyahu congratulated the Slovenian Prime Minister on the opening of the Israeli embassy in Ljubljana and thanked him for his steadfast support for Israel, which has led to a turnaround in bilateral relations.

The two leaders discussed opportunities to deepen cooperation between the two countries in various fields.

Prime Minister Netanyahu invited his counterpart to visit Israel.

flash_694096.description: Anti-Israel activist follows and repeatedly disrupts Kan News reporter Shahar Glick and his cameraman outside the UN, declaring: 'There’s no IDF here.'

flash_694094.description: US and Iranian negotiators reportedly explore a phased deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz in exchange for easing Washington’s economic blockade.

flash_694092.description: Israel’s ambassador to the UN talks with Arutz Sheva about Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s brief visit to New York, marking Iran as a central topic in his remarks and addressing sharp criticism of Israel.

flash_694090.description:
On his way to the United States on Wednesday, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's plane was tracked crossing French airspace despite an International Criminal Court (ICC) arrest warrant issued against him. France, which is a party to the Rome Statute that established the ICC, defended its decision to permit the Israeli government aircraft to pass through its airspace.

French Foreign Ministry spokesman Pascal Confavreux said the authorization was "in full conformity with international law," explaining that France does not consider the Rome Statute to require action against a person named in an ICC warrant merely because the state aircraft carrying that person flies through French airspace.

flash_694089.description: Claims circulated online that hilltop activists were laying siege to homes in Qusra. Drone footage from the scene shows no Israelis surrounding the homes.

flash_694088.description: Israel Police stands by its claim that a tunnel was uncovered in Qalqilya and releases footage from the scene, while the IDF says no tunnel route was found.

flash_694087.description: The credo applied to Israel at war - and only Israel - lays down that Jews can never be innocent.

flash_694086.description: Netanyahu arrives for an unusually brief US visit, heading directly to the UN for his address and meetings with world leaders before returning to Israel.

flash_694085.description: Kosher schach (sukkah 'roof') has to be פסולת גורן ויקב: of the waste of the wheat and vines - the wheat and the grapes themselves cannot be used for schach, as they receive impurity. Where does this waste come from?

flash_694083.description: Mahmoud Samahat, who fatally struck teenager Amichai Attia in Hadera, was released to house arrest. Judge: “Those responsible for the tragic outcome are the people who chased him."

flash_694082.description: Only by delving deeply into the historic roots of the Jewish People can we appreciate what we are meriting to see, and gaze ahead to the future that awaits us.

flash_694140.description:
The Together party commented on Thursday night's incident in Bnei Brak, saying that during former Prime Minister Naftali Bennett’s visit to the city, two objects were thrown at him, striking one of his female staff members in the head. She was treated at the scene by a Magen David Adom team and released without requiring further medical care, the party said.

The party said the incident occurred after Bennett held a “parliament" with several yeshiva students, describing the conversation as having proceeded “in a good and substantive manner." Security forces at the scene arrested the suspect, and Bennett thanked the security and emergency response personnel for their swift action. The party said that “Bennett will continue holding meetings throughout the country as part of the campaign to repair the State of Israel."

flash_694139.description:
During former Prime Minister Naftali Bennett’s visit to a restaurant in Bnei Brak, a passerby threw an object at him that did not strike him, police said.

Officers at the scene immediately arrested the suspect, who was taken to a police station for questioning.

flash_694137.description: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani accuses Netanyahu of spreading “baseless lies" after the Prime Minister criticizes him during his UN speech.

flash_694135.description: As Netanyahu entered the UN hall, bereaved father Itzik Bontzel stood and called out “Am Yisrael Chai": “I shouted loudly for all the nations of the world to hear."

flash_694133.description: Netanyahu: Evil Iranian regime will fall, and we will all celebrate that day

flash_694131.description:
Netanyahu said at the UN General Assembly: "To the protesters outside, to the hypocritical delegates who left this hall, I ask, where were you when the Iranian tyrants buthered and maimed tens of thousands of unarmed Iranian civilians, whent they butchered and maimed thousands of their own people? Where were you?"

"Did you organize mass rallies, hunger strikes? Did you protest outside the Iranian mission to the UN? Did you speak out for Christians persecuted in Iran and throughout the Middle East? No. You didn't do that. Because you're phony human rights protesters."

flash_694130.description: Netanyahu held up a Starlink device at his UN speech. “This is a communications device that enables people to access the truth. That is what the Iranian regime fears. It spends billions to censor the internet. Mr. President, I’m going to leave this device with you, so you can give it to the Iranian delegation, so that when they inevitably defect, they’ll be able to tell their story on social media. One day and that day is not far off, the Iranian people will be free, and their murderous regime will fall."

flash_694128.description:
PM Netanyahu told Mayor Mamdani: "The lies you and other antisemites spread about the Jews and the Jewish State have real consequences. In New York, Jews are threatened on the way to synagogue. Jews have been stabbed in the streets. Jews are demonized, targeted simply for being Jews."

"Jews have been murdered in Sydney, Manchester, Montreal, Boulder Colorado. They've been attacked in Los Angeles, London, Paris, Berlin, Washington DC.

The antisemites of the world want to terrify our people. I have news for them. The days when Jews were defenseless victims, marched to the slaughter, those days are over."

flash_694127.description: PM Netanyahu stated: "Here's a simple truth. Israel didn't commit genocide, Israel prevented genocide. That's exactly what Mr. Mamdani's Hamas buddies would have done to us had we not stopped them. They woudl ahve killed every last one of us."

flash_694125.description: PM Netanyahu stated at the UN General Assembly: "To all those that are spreading these lies about my country and about our brave soldiers, whether they sit in this hall or in the office of the antisemitic mayor of New York, I say this: Shame on you. Shame on you for distorting the facts. Shame on you for inverting victim and aggressor. Shame on you for spitting in the face of truth."

flash_694123.description:
PM Netanyahu called Turkish leader Recep Tayyip Erdogan a "tyrant who has massacred thousands of Kurdish civilians" and noted that he hosts Hamas leaders, jails journalists, and denies the Armenian genocide while occupying northern Cyprus.

"He calls for Israel's destruction almost every single day. He says he is going to be the 'ruler of Jerusalem.' No sir, you won't. This is our country, our city, our eternal capital."

flash_694121.description:
PM Netanyahu told the UN General Assembly that several countries have "spent untold billions to spread lies" about Israel. "The first to do so was Qatar. Decades ago, it started massively funding American universities and toxic media outlets like Al Jazeera. They did the same in Europe."

"Their goal was clear: brainwash young minds to hate Israel, hate America, hate the West. This is the same Qatar that hosts the Hamas butchers who of October 7th."

flash_694119.description: Netanyahu thanks President Trump for supporting Israel in its fight against "barbarians"

flash_694117.description: Netanyahu responds to Macron: A French citizen was murdered in Judea in Samaria

And in particular, they try to murder our people in our historic homeland. By the way, that's where the word Jew comes from, Judea,"

flash_694114.description:
PM Netanyahu held up a beeper during his speech at the UN General Assembly, asking the delegates if they remembered the beeper operation that crippled much of Hezbollah's operations in September 2024.

"Do you remember the beepers?" he asked, adding that "Hezbollah certainly remembers them."

flash_694112.description: PM Netanyahu asked the UN General Assembly if they knew of "any other country the size of New Jersey capable of fighting a 7-front war?"

flash_694138.description: President Herzog welcomes Israel’s sixth submarine, INS Drakon, saying the Navy’s growing capabilities will expand Israel’s operational reach worldwide.

flash_694136.description: Israel’s Ambassador to the United Nations Danny Danon said that representatives of 123 countries, out of the 193 member states, attended Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s address.

flash_694134.description: Netanyahu: The eternity of Israel will not falter, we have no other choice

flash_694129.description: Netanyahu to world Jewry: Raise your head high

flash_694126.description:
PM Netanyahu criticized New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani by name in his UN address. "Mr. Mamdani, since you were elected mayor of this city, many Jews no longer feel safe in New York. They talk to me. They tell me: 'This isn't the city we remember. It changed so quickly.'"

"It's no wonder. You praise criminals convicted of supporting Hamas. You count as friends people like Hasan Piker, who said America deserved 9/11. Some friends you have. You invite into your home a Palestinian journalist who filmed Hamas terrorists beating and torturing Israeli hostages and later admitted that he refused to publish the videos in order to protect - you guessed it - the terrorists. Your wife liked a post praising the October 7th massacre. She liked another post saying Tel Aviv shouldn't exist. You refused to condemn any of that. You falsely, repeatedly accuse Israel of genocide.

"Mr Mamdani, you tried to stop me from coming here. You tried to silence me. Well, you can't silence me, you can't silence the truth."

flash_694124.description:
PM Netanyahu describes Israel's efforts to prevent civilian casualties and Hamas's efforts to maximize civilian casualties and says: "Accusing Israel of genocide is the greatest lie of the century."

Quoting John Spencer, he stated: "Israel has done more to prevent civilian casualties in war than any other military in history."

flash_694122.description: The Taliban's Deobandi Sunnism, the Salafi-jihadist roots of Hayat Tahrir al-Sham and the Houthis' Zaydi Shiism are ideologically different but structurally the same. Opinion.

flash_694163.description: One month before the elections, the Prime Minister addresses concerns over a surprise Hamas attack on the eve of the vote and dismisses rumors of a plea bargain in his trial.

Communications Minister Shlomo Karhi praised Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu following his speech at the United Nations General Assembly, highlighting the line: “The power of the people will overcome the people with power."

Karhi added that Netanyahu “stood tall and proudly gave voice to the State of Israel," saying, “We will continue to stand our ground, with strength and faith, until victory."

A man in his 30s was shot in Nazareth and critically injured.

flash_694186.description: Leading rabbis bid farewell to renowned Kabbalist Rabbi David Shalom Batzri as he is laid to rest, recalling his Torah scholarship, prayer and devotion to G-d.

flash_694185.description:
The IDF is once again reinforcing its forces in several sectors ahead of Sukkot, under the direction of the Chief of Staff, as part of efforts to strengthen security and readiness during the holiday period. Regular battalions and brigade headquarters will remain on standby for rapid deployment until the end of the holidays.

During Sukkot, several combat companies will be assigned to reinforce the sectors, while additional companies will remain in reserve. The forces will remain on alert throughout Chol Hamoed and the second holiday.

Central Command will receive additional reinforcements, including soldiers from the Maglan Unit. Most soldiers at brigade training bases will remain on base during the holiday to maintain operational readiness.

flash_694184.description: Staff Sgt. A., a weapons specialist aboard the INS Rahav submarine, spoke to Arutz Sheva about eagerly awaiting his comrades aboard the INS Drakon and the unique experience of serving at sea.

No sirens were sounded in the communities in accordance with protocol.

flash_694182.description: Master Sgt. (res.) Ofek Moalem, killed alongside Master Sgt. (res.) Nadav Kali from the explosion of an IDF drone, completed his mandatory military service two years ago and immediately continued serving in the reserves.

flash_694178.description: Carlson, a former Fox News commentator, now a prominent voice in anti-Israel discourse, denies the allegations, but Dan Livingston says “Jew" or “Jews" were mentioned 1,546 times on his programs in a single year.

flash_694177.description:
In accordance with the directive of IDF Chief of Staff LTG Eyal Zamir, the 98th Division Headquarters completed its operational preparations earlier today (Friday) to assume responsibility for the Etzion and Judea Brigades in Judea and Samaria, and began commanding them.

The Judea and Samaria Division and the 98th Division, including the territorial brigades, will operate jointly in defense and offense to strengthen security efforts and counter terrorism.

flash_694176.description: Gifted with a brilliant mind, a photographic memory, power of speech and a gigantic love of Yiddishkeit, Rabbi Hutner's own enthusiasm was infectious, sparking and uplifting the souls of his listeners to greater personal spiritual heights and development.

flash_694175.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu shared condolences with the families of the two soldiers who fell in the line of duty in Gaza on Thursday.

“Together with all citizens of Israel, my wife and I grieve over the fall of Master Sergeant (Res.) Nadav Kali and Master Sergeant (Res.) Ofek Moalem in a tragic incident in Gaza yesterday. Nadav and Ofek, of blessed memory, were brave reserve soldiers who defended Israel's security. We embrace their families in their difficult hour and send them our deepest condolences," Netanyahu stated

"The IDF is investigating the incident; all necessary lessons must be learned and implemented to ensure the safety and security of IDF soldiers," he added.

flash_694174.description:
The Tel Aviv District Court on Friday accepted an appeal filed by a suspect arrested overnight after throwing an object inside a restaurant in Bnei Brak while Together Chairman Naftali Bennett was visiting the establishment, and shortened his detention until Sunday.

The suspect was arrested by Bnei Brak-Ramat Gan police officers and members of the Border Police’s Ayalon Unit, questioned and jailed. Earlier, the Tel Aviv Magistrate’s Court had extended his detention until Monday, September 28.

flash_694173.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has landed in Israel following an especially short trip to the United States, where he addressed the United Nations.

flash_694170.description: The irony is shocking: Bibi was forced to enter the United States almost in secret, while Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian walked around unchallenged (apart from protests by the Iranian diaspora). Opinion.

flash_694194.description:
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that during his meeting with US President Donald Trump, Washington proposed holding technical-level trilateral talks in the United Arab Emirates involving the US, Ukraine and Russia.

According to Zelenskyy, no date has yet been set for the meeting, and Ukraine is awaiting the US proposal on the matter.

flash_694192.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu met with a delegation of Chabad rabbis before departing for New York. The delegation presented him with the Four Species and spoke with him ahead of his UN address.

During the meeting, the participants sang “L’chatchila Ariber" with Netanyahu and presented him with the book Oseh Shalom.

Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak Aharonov told Netanyahu: “You are going there carrying a great torch on behalf of the entire Jewish people."

flash_694190.description:
Daniel Umansky, 14, was the Israeli boy killed Friday morning when a Russian drone struck his family’s home in the Pechersk district of central Kyiv. His mother was injured and evacuated for medical treatment.

The family had previously immigrated to Israel but returned to Ukraine about 20 years ago. Israel’s consul, the Federation of Jewish Communities of Ukraine, and Chabad emissaries are assisting the family.
